fields.description: Used by any Model Assignment row that leaves Provider blank. Set this once and Crema works for every interface without configuring all 11 rows individually.
fields.label: Default Provider

fields.description: Used by any row that leaves Model blank.
fields.label: Default Model

fields.description: Used by any row that leaves Isolation User blank. Seeded on install/migrate with a dedicated low-privilege account (see crema.install._ensure_isolation_user) — same fencing rules as a per-row isolation user apply.
fields.label: Default Isolation User

fields.description: Used by any row that leaves Monthly Budget (USD) blank/0. 0 = unlimited. See docs/security.md#budgets.
fields.label: Default Monthly Budget (USD)

fields.description: One row per crema.interfaces.PREDEFINED name — the full, fixed set. A blank Provider/Model/Isolation User falls back to the matching Default above; fill a cell here only to override the default for that one interface. Reconciled (rows added/removed/reordered to match PREDEFINED) on every save.
fields.label: Model Assignments

fields.description: Crema Log rows older than this are deleted daily (crema.automation.cleanup_logs).
fields.label: Log Retention (days)
